$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. ConformanceSuite descriptor per FB-RAT-COM-011 and FB-RAT-DIST-004 (Definition of Ready/Done: contract-first DoR/DoD + the 8 conformance test classes as release governance). Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<ConformanceSuite> (see envelope.schema.json); `suiteId` below is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID.
title: ConformanceSuite

suiteId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this suite (FB-RAT-COM-002).

name.description: Human-readable suite name, e.g. 'CommonContracts envelope+error conformance'.

contractRef.description: Stable identifier of the contract this suite conformance-tests, e.g. a schema '$id' (or repo-relative path) or a Kotlin type FQN.

testClasses.description: The FB-RAT-DIST-004 eight conformance test classes this suite covers, and whether each is JVM-testable in the build container (no device/emulator — see CLAUDE.md 'Environment honesty').

jvmTestable.description: YES = fully exercisable on the JVM gate with no device; PARTIAL = the structural/logic half is JVM-testable but a device-owner-verified half remains; NO = requires a real device/emulator/board and is out of CI's reach entirely.

fixtureDirectoryRef.description: Repo-relative path to the fixtures/ directory this suite reads, containing valid/ invalid/ adversarial/ subfolders per the FIXTURES convention.

definitionOfReady.description: FB-RAT-DIST-004: true only once golden-serialization + state-machine + adversarial + recovery + compatibility + provider-conformance fixtures exist for the referenced contract BEFORE feature implementation begins.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).
